fieldValues.title: One index of decisions across the stores, by stable id, before any decisions server
fieldValues.move: Keep the stores where they are and build one read-only index that lists every decision in every store (record, ADR, rfc-decision, log row, PR block, answered ask) with its id, store, level, state and how it got there, and flags decisions that exist only in a branch or open PR. The index is the evidence for the owner's question whether a decisions server is needed: build a server only if the index shows decisions lost or unfindable that a single store would have kept.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not stop decisions being written in many places, nor give the stores one id scheme; it makes them findable and their losses countable.
fieldValues.falsifier: The index misses decisions that agents later find by hand, or after a month it shows no loss a server would prevent (then no server).
source_ref: Finding: decisions are recorded in at least seven stores with no shared index (2026-10-28)
